highlights: Licence check-ins are simpler: the app no longer sends or checks a one-time code with each check-in, in line with paid licences that keep working offline, as in LightBurn.
Run G-code file is safer: it refuses shell, file, stored-program and FluidNC/grblHAL expression commands, explains M1 per firmware, and forgets the work offsets and Z the program may have changed.
The Material Test card keeps to its hatch floor, fits its column labels, and burns the gentlest cut first.
